_comment: Subject-level 4-fold split used to TRAIN the paper's 3D models (Dataset011). DIFFERENT from the 2D split (subject_split_2D.json): the 3D build used a shuffled assignment. Recovered from the stored held-out predictions_3d (each MagPhase volume sits in its held-out fold) and verified: re-scoring reproduces the paper's 3D lesion numbers. 3D subject-stats read the stored predictions directly, so this file is for provenance/reproducibility.
